correctness.rationale: The defined 24 signed permutations of (0,1,2) and squared-Euclidean-edge-distance-2 graph have 36 edges, cubic valency, graph diameter 6. A separate finite implementation reconstructed all graph-metric cliques at r=2 and 3, face vectors (24,96,112,30) and (24,168,472,618,384,92), and mod-two ranks (∂2,∂3)=(73,30) and (145,326), hence H2 dimensions 9 and 1. Inspecting complete verify.py checks eight oriented octahedral hexagon cycles with private alternating triangles, no scale-2 tetrahedral support, and an unsigned 48-element action; an independent 48 signed-coordinate-permutation trace calculation reproduced trace=det+fixed hexagons at r=2 and det at r=3. The source verifier also computes the complete mod-two inclusion of scale-2 cycle space into the 326-dimensional scale-3 boundary space: rank one; this agrees with an older exact published persistent barcode. Earlier complete integral wedge homotopy types imply torsion-freeness, so nonzero F2 inclusion maps to nonzero rational H2 and an isomorphism on the determinant line; eight face classes bound in the full scale-3 hexagonal simplex. Rational Maschke splitting then gives exactly the claimed G-equivariant intervals [2,3) and [2,4). Scope graph metric, degree-two rational group action only.
